acceptance: forge-cli test: the dialect scaffold for all four dialects writes .forge-interpret; red before the fix for Python, TypeScript and Java.
forge-runtime test: validate_app_bundle and ingest_app_bundle accept a bundle with no app_manifest (API-only) and still refuse an undecodable or invalid one; red before the fix.
interp.rs module doc no longer says the interpreted route runs behind the server-build gate.
Dev stack: forge new --dialect python, forge push, converges and the op answers through the edge; scripted repro (.harness/state/ip2/repro-python-push.sh) and its before/after output in evidence.
author: rory

gaps.description: Diffed the roadmap's IP-2 statement ('smallest fix: write the marker') against a dev-stack run of the marker fix (.harness/state/ip2/after.log, ws-da937bbe844a704a): the marked Python tree takes the interpreted converge and then fails closed 'app_bundle validation failed' (runtime log 09:30:58, reconcile/cycle.rs). Cause: workspace_derive.rs:679-781 omits app_manifest for an app-less workspace since R-8 a818087, while forge-runtime ingest.rs:645-647 (validate_app_bundle) and :87-89 (ingest_app_bundle) require it; R-8 checked reconcile_declared_triggers but not the deploy validator. Every dialect scaffold is app-less, so the marker alone serves no dialect. Closed in the intent: statement and acceptance now cover the runtime admitting an app-less bundle, and the step's scope widens to forge-runtime.
CP-side alternative of synthesizing a default app_manifest
gaps.note: R-8 a818087 deliberately omits the key so nothing deserializes a default app; the runtime is the consumer whose contract R-8 claimed and missed, so the fix goes there.

out_of_scope: Already-scaffolded unmarked workspaces (no CP-side inference of the marker).
Domain workflows/webhooks of an app-less workspace (the CP merges them into app_manifest only when an app exists, workspace_derive.rs:683); recorded, not fixed here.
statement: A workspace made by forge new --dialect in any of Python, TypeScript, Java or Rust carries .forge-interpret at its root, so its first git push takes the interpreted converge (push.rs A0) instead of stopping for want of a forge.lock; and the runtime admits the app-less bundle that converge produces (no app_manifest, omitted by the CP since R-8 a818087) as an API-only deploy instead of failing closed with 'app_bundle validation failed', so the pushed op serves through the edge. interp.rs no longer claims the route sits behind the server-build gate it left at 6d666cd.
